name: AudioStore Phase 4 — CachedSynthesizer Implementation

references.text: Architecture: SuttaPlayer uses dependency injection for ISpeechSynthesizer via init parameter (SuttaPlayer.swift:29). This enables CachedSynthesizer to be injected as drop-in replacement for testing/production.

Design: IPlaybackDelegate (4 events) and ISpeechSynthesizer protocol already defined. SpeechSynthesizerImpl wraps AVSpeechSynthesizer + translates AVSpeechSynthesizerDelegate callbacks to IPlaybackDelegate events. CachedSynthesizer follows identical pattern: wrap AVAudioPlayer + emit same 4 events.

Integration: AudioStore.shared exists (ready to use). AudioContext has hash for cache keys. AudioStore.storeAudio(text:audioContext) async method available. AudioStore not yet imported in scv-ui — CachedSynthesizer will be first UI integration point.

Constraint: AVAudioPlayer requires explicit seek/duration tracking (unlike AVSpeechSynthesizer which provides duration via utterance.duration). Will need to compute duration from synthesized audio file or track via AVAudioPlayerDelegate callbacks.

ARCHITECTURAL DECISION REQUIRED: How does CachedSynthesizer receive AudioStore instance? Options: (1) AudioStore injected into init (requires SuttaPlayer to pass it). (2) CachedSynthesizer creates own instance (needs path config). (3) App provides global AudioStore to CachedSynthesizer (ServiceLocator pattern). Decision affects iOS app startup code.

CRITICAL: AudioStore path must be Application Support (not Caches) on iOS. Reasoning: (1) Caches can be purged by OS, breaking background playback. (2) Application Support persists across app launches, hidden from Files app. (3) Respects Apple audio licensing by preventing casual user access/distribution. (4) Deleted when app uninstalled. Current default (Library/Caches/audio-store) unsuitable.

BLOCKING: AudioStore.shared default path hardcoded to Caches. Must be changed to Application Support before CachedSynthesizer can use it on iOS. AudioStore currently internal (not public) — made public but edit incomplete pending approval.

summary: Implement cached speech synthesis for background audio
